name: @remonta/infra
description: AWS infrastructure for apps/api as code (CDK, TypeScript): the GitHub OIDC deploy role, the ECR repository, and one ApiStack construct instantiated for staging and prod (VPC, ALB + ACM, WAF, ECS Fargate, Secrets Manager references, logs, alarms, dashboard). Synthesises without AWS credentials so it can be tested like any other package.

scripts.quality: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run synth
